title: bus.host.load.finding v1
description: A wasted-load finding from the host-load adapter (who-is-loading --emit): orphaned shell spin loops, stale-cwd processes, pure CPU loops, duplicate builds, memory pressure with its paging causes, CPU pressure. Attributed to a project and, where the process tree or cwd allows, to the agent session (claude/codex/orca worktree) that owns it. Emitted ONLY on level transitions (ok to warn to critical and recovery) after the finding has persisted for two consecutive samples, plus a bounded re-reminder for sustained findings; never per sample. Critical orphan/memory findings additionally fan out a bus.notify.v1. Motivating incident (2026-10-03): 128 `sh -c 'while :; do :; done'` orphans in one agent worktree burned the host for hours and nothing named the agent. Read-only: the adapter never signals, renices or reweights anything; game-priority-watch owns policy.

host.description: Hostname the sample was taken on.

key.description: Stable identity of the condition across samples (kind:project:signature).

level.description: Level after this transition; ok is a recovery.

project.description: Attributed project (docker compose label, repo/worktree owner, unit:<name>, kernel, unknown).

cpu_cores.description: CPU the finding's processes are burning, in cores.

count.description: Number of processes in the finding.

agents.description: Agent sessions that own the processes, most processes first. agent is `<project>/<worktree>` when a worktree is known, `<claude|codex>@<project>#<pid>` for an interactive session, or `orca:<id>`.

evidence.description: Detector evidence (scrubbed command, cwd, paging causes). Shape varies by kind.
